title: Presale buyers can block other whitelisted buyers from purchases
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Per the information provided by the sponsors during the audit  > In Cardex, each card will have a one-day presale stage, and after that will be changed to public > The presale stage is a reward for eligible users. Cardex backend will determine eligible users. Card owner doesn’t have any privileges  Now the presale mechanism uses a nonce-based signature system to authorize buyers.
